timeline.evidenceText: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,
There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and childless.
Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial site of Manoah his father. He judged Israel twenty years.
The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, “Go, explore the land!”
They came to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol; and their brothers asked them, “What do you say?”
The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.
Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.
in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,

definitions.full: H6881. Tsorah צָרְעָה proper name, of a location Σαραα , etc. (compare also Lag BN 85 ), in the Shephelah of Judah (Tel Amarna ‚ar—a , named with Aialuna , Ajalon); — Josh 15:33 , but assigned to Dan 19:41 ; Judg 13:2 , 25 ; 16:31 ; 18:2 , 8 , 11 ; 2Chr 11:10 ; Neh 11:29 ; modern ‚ar±a , 15 miles west from Jerusalem, compare GASm Geogr. 218 Buhl Geogr.195 .
